description: This file defines the 'AuditSection' class, which is an embeddable JPA entity used for tracking audit information such as creation and modification dates, and the user who modified the record.

classes.name: AuditSection
classes.description: An embeddable class that holds audit information with fields for creation date, modification date, and modifier identifier.

methods.name: getDateCreated
methods.description: Returns a clone of the creation date to prevent unintended modifications.

methods.name: setDateCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation date, cloning the provided date to maintain encapsulation.

methods.name: getDateModified
methods.description: Returns a clone of the modification date.

methods.name: setDateModified
methods.description: Sets the modification date, cloning the input date.

methods.name: getModifiedBy
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the user who last modified the record.
